AttachBaremetalServerVolume.name: AttachBaremetalServerVolume
AttachBaremetalServerVolume.summary: Attaching an EVS Disk to a BMS
AttachBaremetalServerVolume.description: This API is used to attach EVS disks to a BMS as data disks after the BMS is created if existing disks are insufficient or cannot meet requirements.

BatchRebootBaremetalServers.name: BatchRebootBaremetalServers
BatchRebootBaremetalServers.description: This API is used to restart BMSs of specified IDs.

BatchStartBaremetalServers.name: BatchStartBaremetalServers
BatchStartBaremetalServers.description: This API is used to start BMSs of specified IDs.

BatchStopBaremetalServers.name: BatchStopBaremetalServers
BatchStopBaremetalServers.description: This API is used to stop BMSs of specified IDs.

ChangeBaremetalServerOs.name: ChangeBaremetalServerOs
ChangeBaremetalServerOs.description: This API is used to change the BMS OS. Password and key pair injection are supported during OS change.

CreateBareMetalServers.name: CreateBareMetalServers
CreateBareMetalServers.description: This API is used to create one or more BMSs.Logging in to a BMS can be authenticated using either a key pair or password. For security purposes, you are advised to use key pair authentication.

DeleteWindowsBareMetalServerPassword.name: DeleteWindowsBareMetalServerPassword
DeleteWindowsBareMetalServerPassword.summary: Deleting the Password of a Windows BMS
DeleteWindowsBareMetalServerPassword.description: This API is used to delete the random password generated during initial Windows BMS installation. After the password is deleted, you can still use your password to log in to your BMS. However, you cannot use the Get Password function to recover the BMS initial password. If the BMS is created from a private image, ensu…

DetachBaremetalServerVolume.name: DetachBaremetalServerVolume
DetachBaremetalServerVolume.summary: Detaching an EVS Disk from a BMS
DetachBaremetalServerVolume.description: This API is used to detach a disk from a BMS. A disk attached to /dev/sda functions as the system disk. You can only detach the system disk from a stopped BMS. Disks attached to a mount point other than /dev/sda function as data disks and can be detached from a running or stopped BMS. Stopped and Running indicate that…

ListBaremetalFlavorDetailExtends.name: ListBaremetalFlavorDetailExtends
ListBaremetalFlavorDetailExtends.summary: Querying Details About Flavors and Extended Flavor Information
ListBaremetalFlavorDetailExtends.description: This API is used to query details about BMS flavors and extended flavor information. You can call this API to query the value of parameter baremetal:extBootType to check whether a flavor supports quick BMS provisioning.

ListBareMetalServerDetails.name: ListBareMetalServerDetails
ListBareMetalServerDetails.description: This API is used to query BMS details. The information that can be queried includes the BMS billing mode and whether the BMS is frozen.

ListBareMetalServers.name: ListBareMetalServers
ListBareMetalServers.description: This API is used to query BMSs by filters and display details about the BMSs.The information that can be queried includes the BMS billing mode and whether the BMS is frozen.

ListBareMetalServersDetail.name: ListBareMetalServersDetail
ListBareMetalServersDetail.summary: Query the bare metal server list.
ListBareMetalServersDetail.description: Users can filter bare metal servers based on the request conditions and obtain detailed information about the bare metal servers.

ReinstallBaremetalServerOs.name: ReinstallBaremetalServerOs
ReinstallBaremetalServerOs.description: This API is used to reinstall the BMS OS. The OS of BMSs supporting quick provisioning can be reinstalled using the original image without any change to the data disks. Password and key pair injection are supported during OS reinstallation.

ResetPwdOneClick.name: ResetPwdOneClick
ResetPwdOneClick.summary: Resetting the BMS Password with a Few Clicks
ResetPwdOneClick.description: This API is used to reset the password of the BMS management account (root or Administrator) when one-click password reset is supported.You can use the Querying Whether One-Click Password Reset Is Supported API to check whether one-click password reset is supported.

ShowBaremetalServerInterfaceAttachments.name: ShowBaremetalServerInterfaceAttachments
ShowBaremetalServerInterfaceAttachments.summary: Querying NICs Attached to a BMS
ShowBaremetalServerInterfaceAttachments.description: This API is used to query information about NICs attached to a BMS, such as the IP address and MAC address of each NIC.

ShowBaremetalServerVolumeInfo.name: ShowBaremetalServerVolumeInfo
ShowBaremetalServerVolumeInfo.summary: Querying EVS Disks Attached to a BMS
ShowBaremetalServerVolumeInfo.description: Querying EVS Disks Attached to a BMS

ShowJobInfos.name: ShowJobInfos
ShowJobInfos.description: This interface is used to query the execution status of a task, such as ECS creation, ECS deletion, ECS batch operation, and NIC operation.After a task, such as creating a BMS or attaching disks, is delivered, job_id is returned, based on which you can query the execution status of the task.

ShowMetadataOptions.name: ShowMetadataOptions
ShowMetadataOptions.description: This API is used to query specified BMS metadata options.

ShowResetPwd.name: ShowResetPwd
ShowResetPwd.summary: Querying Whether One-Click Password Reset Is Supported
ShowResetPwd.description: Querying Whether One-Click Password Reset Is Supported

ShowSpecifiedVersion.name: ShowSpecifiedVersion
ShowSpecifiedVersion.description: This API is used to query a specified API version.

ShowTenantQuota.name: ShowTenantQuota
ShowTenantQuota.description: This API is used to query the quotas of all resources for a specified tenant, including used quotas.

ShowVersionsInfo.name: ShowVersionsInfo
ShowVersionsInfo.description: This API is used to query all available API versions of the BMS service.

ShowWindowsBaremetalServerPwd.name: ShowWindowsBaremetalServerPwd
ShowWindowsBaremetalServerPwd.summary: Obtaining the Password of a Windows BMS
ShowWindowsBaremetalServerPwd.description: This API is used to query the random password of the administrator (account Administrator or an account configured using Cloudbase-Init) generated by the system during the installation of a Windows BMS. If the BMS is created from a private image, ensure that Cloudbase-Init has been installed. Cloudbase-Init is install…

UpdateBaremetalServerMetadata.name: UpdateBaremetalServerMetadata
UpdateBaremetalServerMetadata.description: This API is used to update BMS metadata. If the metadata does not contain the target field, the field is automatically added to the field. If the metadata contains the target field, the field value is automatically updated. If the field in the metadata is not requested, the field value remains unchanged.

UpdateMetadataOptions.name: UpdateMetadataOptions
UpdateMetadataOptions.description: This API is used to update specified BMS metadata options. You can use this API to enable or disable the IMDS service or select an IMDS service version.
